details.goal: Create an installable Bun/TS project whose package.json#imports map is the module boundary, with every script later phases need frozen up front.

tasks.title: Envelope and the emit() budget chokepoint

details.goal: Freeze the response contract and the single size chokepoint.
details.contract:
envelope.ts exports type Envelope<T> with NINE REQUIRED fields always present — status, summary, read_status, coverage, totals, truncated, truncation_reason, next, next_tools — plus payload:T, plus ONE OPTIONAL error present if and only if status is error or bootstrapping. read_status is {generation, indexed_at, stale, stale_reason?, stale_checked_at?}. coverage is {complete, indexed, skipped, failed, unresolved_edges, not_indexed[]}. totals is {*_total, total_relation: eq|gte}. error is {code, message, hint?, retryable?, retry_after_ms?}. Constructors ok/ambiguous/notFound/fail/bootstrapping return the full shape, never a partial object.
budget.ts exports emit(env, budgetTokens, opts: {mint: (position: number) => string}) — the ONLY place a payload is truncated: serialise, measure at 4 bytes per token, drop lowest-ranked items from the largest list until within budget, preserve every *_total, set truncated, truncation_reason and next via opts.mint, and DOWNGRADE totals.total_relation from eq to gte when it truncates. Refuse budgetTokens above 32000 with AppError budget_too_large.
Signing is not in this task: callers pass the mint callback. No source file in shared may construct an Envelope literal outside envelope.ts.

budget.ts exports: BYTES_PER_TOKEN=4, MAX_BUDGET_TOKENS=32_000, EmitOptions {mint}, emit(). emit measures Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(env)) at 4 B/token, clones the payload via JSON round-trip (caller arrays are never mutated), collects every array (nested lists included), drops the last (lowest-ranked) item of the largest list one at a time until within budget, sets truncated/truncation_reason="budget"/next=opts.mint(dropped) exactly once, downgrades totals.total_relation eq->gte while preserving every *_total, and throws AppError budget_too_large above 32 000. details.contract: cursor.ts exports sign(payload:{generation, tool, argsHash, position}) returning an opaque token, and verify(token, {tool, argsHash, generation}) returning a discriminated result (ok with decoded position) | cursor_invalid | cursor_expired | cursor_mismatch. HMAC-SHA256 over a key from env CODEGRAPH_CURSOR_KEY with a length check at startup; the key never leaves this module. Expiry is generation-bound, not time-bound: a token whose generation differs from the current one is cursor_expired with hint re-run the original call, and a token whose tool or argsHash differ is cursor_mismatch. Tokens are base64url of payload plus 16-byte tag; no database table and no server memory. tests/cursor.test.ts covers round trip, tampered tag, expired generation, mismatched tool and mismatched argsHash.
